To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

title.narrative: Annual Output Results
Output Indicator

description.narrative: - Number of consultations on National Development Plan (3-year and 1-year plans). - Adequate resources mobilized for the implementation of DPG Phase VI project. - Quarterly and Annual progress reports and follow-up of action points. - Number of AMP refresher training organized for focal points. - Annual Statistical bulletin.

comment.narrative: DPG harmonized and aligned development cooperation to GTP II implementation in prioritized sectors. - 12 DPG Sector Working Groups provides technical support to the implementation of GTPII. - Regular consultation of DPG with GoE on strategic development topics and issues.

- Support MPD to prepare Voluntary National Review Report on Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). - Hire an international consultant to reorganize Sector Working Groups to align with GoE structural and national priorities. - Mobilize adequate volume of resources for the implementation of 2022 AWP. - Support MoF to implement AMP exit plan and autonomously manage the AMP. - DPG secretariat to provide effective and efficient service to DPG members. - Provide regular AMP new-user and refresher training to AMP focal points. - Prepare annual ODA Statistical Bulletin for EFY 2014 - Support MPD to roll-out DRMS to all line ministries and relevant government institutions.

- Ethiopia present the VNR report on the High Level Political Forum in New York in July 2022 - The consultant submitted a draft inception report on how to streamline SWGs and develop mutual accountability framework.

Support Ministry of Planning and Development to implement the medium-term (3-year) national development plan at national and sub-national levels and Ministry of Finance to contribute to the achievement of 2030 Agenda integrated in the national development plans in line with aid-effectiveness principles with adequate financing mobilized at national and sub-national level. - One consultation on the medium-term (3-year) and annual development plan on prioritized sectors. - Priorities identified by GoE and DPG to support the implementation of the 10-year plan. - Adequate volume of resources mobilized for the implementation of DPG Phase VI project. - Efficient DPG Secretariat. - Annual AMP refresher and new user training to 20 AMP focal points - Annual (EFY 2013) ODA Statistical Bulletin produced - Increased AMP data utilization by MoF and DPs. - Number of reports produced using AMP data

- A consultative meeting between the GoE including Ministries of Finance, Peace and Planning and Development and DPG meeting was held on the overall macro-economic, humanitarian and 10-year development plan was held. - Monthly DPG HoA and ExCom meetings were held and action points and decisions of the meetings were followed up and implemented by the DPG Secretariat. - The AMP Coordinator at MoF organized trainings for new users and refresher AMP trainings as per demand from development partner agencies. - MoF is verifying data entered by AMP focal points of DPG member agencies in preparation for the drafting of the ODA statistical bulletin.
